name: CPU Energy Performance Preference
description: Sets the processor energy performance preference to prioritize speed over power savings, allowing the CPU to run more aggressively under load.

description_i18n.en: Sets the processor energy performance preference to prioritize speed over power savings, allowing the CPU to run more aggressively under load.
description_i18n.de: Stellt die Energieleistungspräferenz des Prozessors auf Geschwindigkeit statt Energiesparmodus ein und ermöglicht dem Prozessor eine aggressivere Leistung unter Last.
description_i18n.fr: Configuré la préférence de performance énergétique du processeur pour privilégier la vitesse par rapport à l'économie d'énergie, permettant au CPU de fonctionner plus agressivement sous charge.

warnings.title: Increased Power Usage
warnings.message: This tweak prioritizes performance over power savings, which may increase battery drain and heat output on laptops

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the Windows power configuration registry values for AC and DC schemes using the SUB_PROCESSOR group Changes the PERFEPP setting to value 0 (performance) or 50 (balanced)
